checkpoint_review: The Router's verdicts are accurate and appropriately critical. It correctly identified that while some color/texture elements (grey plumage) are present, the defining structural features of a pelican (gular pouch, barrel torso, S-curved neck) are absent or catastrophically distorted. The marking of 'is_testable: false' for legs is correct as they are completely occluded or dissolved. The Router was not too lenient; in fact, it correctly penalized the 'melting' artifacts which destroy the biological validity of the subject.
artifact_review: The Router's severity ratings are justified. Severity 5 for 'melting' is appropriate because the subjects literally dissolve into abstract streaks, losing all anatomical coherence. Severity 4 for 'structural collapse' on the right-side bird is also correct; while it looks more like a bird, the wing-body connection is physically impossible. The topology auditor's mask confirms this fragmentation, showing disconnected 'islands' of pixels that correspond to the floating/dissolving parts. The perceptual quality auditor's 'null' finding is a blind spot—it only checks for compression/noise, not structural melting, so its positive report should be ignored in favor of the Router's visual observation of melting.
alignment_reasoning: The fine-grained classifier failed to identify the image as a 'pelican', ranking 'kite' and 'albatross' higher. This confirms that the generated image lacks the specific semantic features (especially the bill/pouch) required for class conformance. Only 1 out of 8 testable checkpoints passed (plumage color), and even that is compromised by texture smearing. The structural failure is total.
artifact_reasoning: Catastrophic structural artifacts dominate the image. Multiple subjects exhibit 'melting' (severity 5), where bodies dissolve into vertical streaks. Detached wings float without connection to bodies (topological fragmentation confirmed by SAM mask). The most intact subject still shows warped geometry and low-confidence pose keypoints (53% low confidence), indicating widespread structural uncertainty. The image is structurally nonsensical.
key_defects: Catastrophic melting/dissolving of subject bodies into abstract streaks
Detached/floating wing structures with no body connection
